description: This file defines and exports the setup wizard configuration for the iMessage channel within the application. It imports functions and types to manage setup status, detect binary paths, and handle related configuration for iMessage integration.

methods.name: detectBinary
methods.description: Detects the presence of the iMessage CLI binary in the system, used to verify if iMessage tools are available.

methods.name: setSetupChannelEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the setup channel configuration based on the provided configuration object.

methods.name: createDetectedBinaryStatus
methods.description: Creates a status object indicating whether the required binary for the channel has been detected.

methods.name: createIMessageCliPathTextInput
methods.description: Generates a text input interface element for specifying the path to the iMessage CLI.

methods.name: resolveIMessageAccount
methods.description: Resolves account details for a given iMessage account ID.
